findings.title: Production kitchen UI queries hot-line while submitted tickets use kitchen-main
Operational bill splitting is not connected to a production route
Fresh-system floor-plan and chair setup is unreachable
Table merge and subsequent unmerge cannot be completed
Reservation UI does not persist typed party size or bounded reservation time
Catalog tabs are clipped at narrow widths and 400 percent reflow
Desktop composition fails the restaurant-operation designer quality bar
Live accessibility, native zoom and complete focus-order evidence is incomplete
Mandatory external device, provider, backup, security and signed go-live evidence is absent
